name: Kūpuna Care
agency: Hawaii DOH Executive Office on Aging; implemented through county area agencies on aging
jurisdiction: Hawaii statewide through county aging offices

effective_period.scope: Current HRS §§349-16 and 349-17 and DOH referral page checked; consolidated law is not a new 2026 effective date.

criteria_summary: Long-term services and supports to help older adults age at home and support caregivers. Care-recipient definition includes age 60+, citizenship/qualified-alien criteria, no comparable services, residence outside long-term-care facility, and functional/cognitive impairment criteria. Area agency assessment and support plan determine eligibility; funding availability applies.
missing_facts: In-home assessment and individualized support plan

referral.next_step: Contact the county office on aging for assessment and available services.
